2125299294013927432.en_summary: Meta $META's Muse AI agent can now shop Walmart's Black Friday deals and check out for you, a real test of agents with spending limit. Per Walmart instructions reported by The Verge, set Agent Profile with spending limit like $50 $100 or $200, check out inside Muse conversation at same prices as Walmart.com via Agent Gateway and Sparky. Amazon and eBay blocked AI agents while Walmart opens the door. For Meta this gives path from chat to checkout at biggest retailer during holiday peaks, and every such agent is inference demand. Caveat: details as reported, start date moved between Nov 23 and 24, no usage revenue share or Meta commentary disclosed. $WMT $AMZN $GOOGL $MSFT
2125299294013927432.zh_summary: Meta $META 的 Muse AI 代理現在可以購物 Walmart 的黑色星期五優惠並為你結帳，是帶有支出限額代理的真正測試。根據 The Verge 報導的 Walmart 指示，設定帶有如 $50、$100 或 $200 支出限額的代理檔案，在 Muse 對話內以與 Walmart.com 相同價格結帳，透過代理閘道和 Sparky。Amazon 和 eBay 已阻止 AI 代理，而 Walmart 則開門。對 Meta 而言，這在假期高峰期提供從聊天到最大零售商結帳的路徑，每個這樣的代理都是推理需求。注意：細節如報告所述，開始日期在 11 月 23 日和 24 日間變動，無使用量、收入分成或 Meta 評論披露。$WMT $AMZN $GOOGL $MSFT
